content_sections.heading: About BEEI
content_sections.text: According to the notice, BEEI has 08 educational institutions imparting education to children from Pre-KG to Degree courses. Its office is at Jalahalli Post, Bengaluru - 560013. The posts are for various institutions of BEEI, and all are on fixed tenure.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 10 posts in total across five subjects. Candidates may apply for only one post. The notice does not print a category-wise break-up of these posts.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Every post requires a minimum of 3 years of teaching experience as on 01.10.2026. Qualifications are given below as printed in the notice. The cut-off date for deciding the maximum permissible age and post-qualification experience is 01.10.2026. Experience is counted from the month immediately after the month of the final examination in which the candidate acquired the essential educational qualification. Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. The Selection Committee's decision on professional post-qualification experience is final, and work experience without supporting documents will not be considered. The upper age limit is 45 Years for the UR category, as on 01.10.2026. The notice applies this limit to General Category candidates. The EWS / Caste / Disability certificate must be strictly in the format available on the BEEI website. Otherwise the candidate is considered under General category, provided all criteria for General candidates are met.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Salary is consolidated: Rs 54175 (Special Educator and Social Science), Rs 37500 (All Subjects), Rs 41300 (English) and Rs 69250 (Lecturer in Sanskrit). All posts are on Fixed Tenure basis for three years. Fixed Tenure engagement to Permanent appointment is not automatic. Posting is in Bengaluru. No Travelling Allowance (TA) shall be given. A teacher must submit an application to the Secretary Management Committee one month in advance for outside jobs and for pursuing higher studies.

content_sections.heading: BEEI Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice prints one list of duties and responsibilities for all the teacher posts: Set annual goals before the end of June every year and prepare an annual programme of work. Be present in the school 15 minutes before the commencement bell, attend the morning prayer and assist in maintaining discipline during it. Leave 15 minutes after the closure bell, after reporting to the HOI or Administrative Officer. Draw up daily lesson plans, study books relevant to the subject and use relevant teaching aids. Update computer skills and customised online teaching. Identify learning disabilities through diagnostic tests, chalk out a bridge course, and prepare an action plan and individual education plan (IEP) for remedial teaching. Engage classes as per the time table, with a lesson plan, so that students achieve the prescribed learning outcomes. Prepare a resourceful activity bank, use electronic media and facilitate participatory learning. Give meaningful homework, correct mistakes, guide needy students and report habitual defaulters to the HOI. Conduct periodical tests and examinations, evaluate performance, make entries in the marks card / SATS software, communicate with parents and help students who lag behind. Assist students to overcome mental blocks or other deficiencies by counselling or persuasive means, without resorting to punishment. Develop students' talents through programmes like elocution, essay writing, quiz, painting and sports meet, consulting the HOI / Administrative Officer. Be responsible for the overall academic and co-curricular performance of the class, completion of lessons, maintenance of registers and achievement of prescribed learning outcomes. Maintain the work done diary and documents pertaining to Continuous and Comprehensive Evaluation. Attend meetings of the institution unless exempted by the Head of the Institution, and assist the HOI in carrying out the HOI's duties. Participate in all functions, programmes and developmental activities organised by the school. Resolve genuine grievances of students and parents. Conduct extra classes even on holidays if the prescribed syllabus is not taught within the stipulated period. Engage extra classes in the absence of teachers on leave or OOD, and special classes for remedial teaching when entrusted by the HOI. Do not skip practical classes in the respective subjects; maintain a logbook of practicals. Complete any other work entrusted by the Management Committee, Administrative Officer and HOI, working in team spirit. Co-operate with colleagues, subordinates, superiors, students and parents for the smooth completion of curriculum activities. Discharge any additional work entrusted by the HOI, higher ups or Management within the time frame.

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection is through a Written Test for shortlisted candidates, followed by an Interview only for those who qualify in the Written Test. The written test carries 70% of the marks and the interview 30%. The venue for the written test and interview will be intimated through e-mail. Candidates who pass the written test will be called for interview in a 1:5 ratio. The names of candidates shortlisted for the written test or interview, and the final selections, will be notified on the BEEI website. Short listing is carried out purely on the information declared in the application form. Merely meeting the minimum qualification and experience gives no right to be called for the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for BEEI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates apply online through the link given in the notice, https://jobapply.in/beei2026jalahalliteachers . The online application starts on 4 November 2026 and ends on 24 November 2026. Enter all information correctly, because changes are not permitted after the application form is submitted. Candidates may apply for only one post. An application for more than one post is summarily rejected. Applications sent through e-mail or any other channel will not be considered. The notice gives no date for the written test or interview. Technical support for the online form is available at [email protected] . For further details, candidates may call 080 - 23452377. The notice states that no other mode of communication will be entertained.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: These documents are to be submitted at the time of interview. A candidate who does not submit them on the interview date will not be allowed to attend the interview. SSLC / 10th Standard Marks Card (as proof of Date of Birth) HSC / 12th Standard Marks Card Final Consolidated UG Marks Sheet and UG Degree Certificate or equivalent examination, as applicable Final Consolidated PG Marks Sheet and PG Degree Certificate or equivalent examination, as applicable Final Consolidated Degree Marks Sheet and Degree Certificate of B Ed, as applicable For CGPA / OGPA / Grade-point, the formula for conversion to percentage as per the respective University norms Caste / Community / Disability certificate in the prescribed format Post-qualification experience certificate(s) from the previous / current employer. If the current employment certificate is not produced, the offer of current employment, latest month payslip and employee ID proof must be attached Candidates working in PSUs / Govt. organizations must submit a No Objection Certificate at the time of application, written test or interview Identity Proof (Aadhaar card / Driving License / Voter ID)

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in BEEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 10 vacancies: Special Educator 2, All Subjects 1, English 3, Social Science 3 and Lecturer in Sanskrit 1.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for BEEI teacher posts?
faq.answer: The online application ends on 24.11.2026. It starts on 04.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Lecturer in Sanskrit post?
faq.answer: The post needs an M.A in Sanskrit with minimum 55% of marks and minimum 3 years of teaching experience as on 01.10.2026. Preference is given to those with NET, SLET, M Phil or Ph.D.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for BEEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 45 Years for UR as on 01.10.2026. OBC (NCL) get 3 years, SC/ST 5 years and PwBD 10 years extra, and spouses of deceased BEL employees are relaxed up to 55 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for BEEI teacher posts?
faq.answer: Consolidated salary is Rs 54175 for Special Educator and Social Science, Rs 37500 for All Subjects, Rs 41300 for English and Rs 69250 for Lecturer in Sanskrit.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for BEEI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the notice, https://jobapply.in/beei2026jalahalliteachers, between 04.11.2026 and 24.11.2026. Applications by e-mail or any other channel are not considered.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for BEEI teachers?
faq.answer: A written test (70% marks) is held for shortlisted candidates, followed by an interview (30% marks) for those who qualify. The written test lasts 90 minutes, and candidates are called for interview in a 1:5 ratio.

faq.question: Q8. Is the BEEI teacher job permanent?
faq.answer: No. All posts are on Fixed Tenure basis for three years, and moving from Fixed Tenure to Permanent appointment is not automatic.

faq.question: Q9. Can I apply for more than one post at BEEI?
faq.answer: No. Candidates may apply for only one post, and an application for more than one post is summarily rejected.

faq.question: Q10. Will BEEI pay travelling allowance for the test or interview?
faq.answer: No Travelling Allowance (TA) shall be given.
